product.olivetti-m30030.summary: 25 MHz i486SX desktop with VLSI VL82C486 chipset and integrated WD90C31 video.
product.olivetti-m30030.history: The M300-30 is the 25 MHz i486SX version of this 1992–1993 M300 platform. It shares its board, firmware and peripherals with the M300-30P, which has a DX2/50; BluMach offers them as two machines so that each has its own processor.
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.verifi: Diagnostics 1.04 has completed POST, CPU, cache, memory, keyboard, RTC and protected-mode tests, booted MS-DOS 5.00 and retained the calendar. At 4 MB, memory is accounted as 640 KB base + 3072 KB extended + 384 KB dedicated = 4096 KB.
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.limita: Partial bootable emulation. The VL82C486 is an initial model; the WD90C31 uses the compatible WD90C30 core and the PC87311/87312 is approximated with PC873xx. The board configuration register, from which the BIOS reads the bus speed and the Super I/O address, has been reconstructed from the disassembly. The other documented RAM configurations and more software remain to be validated.
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.manual: Olivetti service guide chapter 36; primary source for M300-30 and M300-30P.
product.olivetti-m30030.creation.storage: No hard disk: one 1.44 MB floppy drive
product.olivetti-m30030.creation.model: M300-30 with a 25 MHz i486SX, 4 MB, integrated WD90C31 and one 1.44 MB floppy drive
product.olivetti-m30030.creation.note: If you add the disk, choose the type shown in the option in Setup. The three images carry the same OVC 1.09 video BIOS.
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.cpu: 25 MHz Intel i486SX. VLSI VL82C486 chipset, combining the memory and AT-bus controller.
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.memory: 4 to 36 MB (4, 8, 12, 20, 24 or 36 MB). With 4 MB, POST counts 640 KB base, 3072 KB extended and 384 KB dedicated: the 384 KB behind the hole between 640 KB and 1 MB are reserved for video and BIOS shadowing.
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.video: Integrated Western Digital WD90C31 VGA with 1 MB. Its video BIOS, OVC 1.09, takes the lower half of the ROM.
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.storag: PC87311/87312-family Super I/O (floppy, serial and parallel) and a buffered IDE interface. The BIOS table adds types 17 to 26 for IDE disks, including type 17 (805/4/26, 40 MB) and type 18 (776/8/33, 100 MB).
product.olivetti-m30030.technical.firmwa: Three 128 KB ROMs with the same OVC 1.09 video BIOS are preserved: Diagnostics 1.03 (09/24/92), 1.04 (11/05/92) and 2.00 (02/22/93). The BIOS reads the bus speed (25 or 33 MHz) and the Super I/O address from a board register, which it opens with keyboard-controller command 8Bh.
